title: Parts Velocity appears under a new Parts section in the Reports navigation
permissions_required: Manager or Office User role (Reports section access) plus the Inventory Reports → View permission (S1-R4).
preconditions: 1. You are signed in to the ShopView App as a user with the Manager or Office User role.
2. Your role has the Inventory Reports → View permission.
steps: 1. Open the Reports section from the main navigation.
2. Look through the report groupings for a section heading named Parts.
3. Click the entry labeled Parts Velocity.
expected: 1. A Parts section heading exists in the Reports navigation (this feature creates it - the application had no Parts reports before).
2. Under Parts there is an entry labeled Parts Velocity (the only Parts report in this release).
3. Clicking it opens the Parts Velocity report.
design_ref: none - SPEC-ONLY (Report Suite: no designs yet; design-reconciliation later if Figma arrives)
notes: The spec is explicit that the Parts grouping does NOT exist today and must be added by this feature (S1-R1). VIU-confirm the exact placement and styling of the new Parts heading in the Reports navigation.
